title: Deformation and Fracture of NiTi Instruments Using Adaptive Reciprocation Intelligent or Fixed-Angle Reciprocation Settings
html: To compare the canal number at first visible deformation, the number of simulated canals completely prepared before fracture, and fractured-fragment length of One RECI instruments operated using fixed-angle conventional reciprocation or the Adaptive Reciprocation Intelligent (ARI) setting.
